extracted.name: Gobi manchurian
extracted.description: My husband loved to eat this so trendy dish of Indian street fastfood. #mommasrecipes
instruction_lines: Mix all the ingredients of marination and add cauliflower then mix well and coat well.rest it for 1 hour almost
Now deep fry it at medium flame
Gravy=roast in some butter garlic and ginger and onion
Make brown then add tomato paste and all the spices together
Now stir at low flame and cover the utensil and cook it for 15 minutes
Now add fried cauliflower florets and do not cook now just mix in tadka mixture
Serve and garnish with spring onions
